Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the thread of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A canyon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the saffron of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on economic security through validator rotation.
